questions.question: The source places Soltaniyeh in present-day Azerbaijan, while [UNESCO](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1188/) places the city in Iran. Proposed wording: “Soltaniyeh, Persia (now Iran)”, with the corresponding Russian correction. Agree the geographical wording.

localizations.source: The source places Soltaniyeh in present-day Azerbaijan, while [UNESCO](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1188/) places the city in Iran. Proposed wording: “Soltaniyeh, Persia (now Iran)”, with the corresponding Russian correction. Agree the geographical wording.
localizations.ru: В исходнике Сольтание отнесено к современному Азербайджану, а [ЮНЕСКО](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1188/) относит город к Ирану. Предлагается уточнить в обеих версиях: «Сольтание, Персия (ныне Иран)» / “Soltaniyeh, Persia (now Iran)”. Нужна редакторская правка географической формулировки.

questions.resolution: Both editions give the location of Soltaniyeh as documented by [UNESCO](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1188/).

questions.question: Check Shahrukh’s transfer of power, the observatory date and instrument type—quadrant or sextant—the destruction chronology, and the absolute claims about the last major scholar and every European observatory.

localizations.source: Check Shahrukh’s transfer of power, the observatory date and instrument type—quadrant or sextant—the destruction chronology, and the absolute claims about the last major scholar and every European observatory.
localizations.ru: Проверить передачу власти Шахрухом, дату постройки и вид инструмента (квадрант или секстант), хронологию разрушения обсерватории и абсолютные оценки «последний крупный учёный» и «во всех обсерваториях Европы».

questions.resolution: The observatory date, main instrument, destruction history and absolute claims were corrected from the [UNESCO Astronomy and World Heritage Portal](https://web.astronomicalheritage.net/show-entity?identity=30) and the Max Planck Institute’s [ISMI record](https://ismi.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/index.php/node/402433).
